title: Symvoulio independent review
description: What the Independent Reviewer returns for one revision (spec 12, step 2). Strict form: every property is required and no other property is allowed, so the same file works as `codex exec --output-schema` and `claude -p --json-schema`. An issue that is still open in this revision keeps the issue_id it had in an earlier review; a new issue gets a new id R<round>-<nnn>.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on the state of this revision.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion this issue fails, quoted.

evidence.description: Where in the revision: section, paragraph or quote.

status.description: resolved: an issue fixed in this revision, including a new finding reported already resolved.
